owner_authorization.decision: Provisional ranking now: group funds with provisional evidence, clearly labelled provisional; build and test ranking and buy calls now; finish the SEC taxonomy alongside and swap it in as it completes.
owner_authorization.scope: Ranking, provisional recommendations and the UIP package for the certified Phase 3 model universe only. Does not certify taxonomy, does not authorize individual stocks, allocation or execution.

taxonomy.replaced_by: certified SEC taxonomy, fund by fund, as it is certified
taxonomy.point_in_time: research classifies at each December with the trailing 36 months of returns and keeps the group for the following year; the live package uses the same December classification (funds without enough history then are classified on arrival and keep that group until the next December)

definitions.mom_12_1: total return from 12 months to 1 month before the month-end
definitions.mom_6: total return over the last 6 months
definitions.stretch_60m: total-return index divided by its average over the last 60 month-ends
definitions.vol_1y: annualized volatility of daily total returns over the last 252 sessions
definitions.maxdd_3y: worst peak-to-trough fall in total return over the last 756 sessions
definitions.dd_now: total-return index against its running peak
definitions.yield_12m: distributions over the last 252 sessions divided by the close
definitions.log_adv_63: log of the 63-session median dollar volume

factors.selection: a factor enters the composite, with the sign of its mean training IC, only when |t| >= 2.0 on yearly blocks and at least 5 training years exist
factors.composite: mean of signed within-group percentile ranks of the selected factors

targets.primary: forward 12-month total return minus the peer-group median
targets.strategic: forward 36-month annualized total return minus the peer-group median

walk_forward.training: all month-ends whose target window ended before the first day of the test year
walk_forward.evaluation: each month-end: quintiles of the composite within each peer group; yearly means of top, bottom and median-relative excess returns

gate.family_condition: calls are enabled for a group family (US equity, international equity, bonds, other) only when the 12-month gate passes overall and that family's own top-quintile mean excess is positive in at least 55% of test years

calls.hysteresis: a fund keeps BUY while its percentile stays at or above 70, and keeps AVOID while it stays at or below 30, so adjacent rank changes alone do not flip calls
requires: group family enabled by the gate

timing.baseline: monthly buying of the family's equal-weight index
timing.gate: a rule may change the when-to-buy reading for a family only if it beats monthly buying in at least 60% of 36-month out-of-sample starts with a median edge of at least +0.5%

known_limitations: Survivorship: the model universe is funds alive today with five years of history, so funds that closed are absent from the backtest.

Provisional taxonomy: returns-based groups can mix strategies that the SEC taxonomy would separate. Short-term municipal funds (SHM, SUB, JMST) still land in high yield because no reference fund is a short-duration municipal fund, and a leveraged fund whose index has no unlevered ETF in the universe at 0.975 correlation (USD, 2x semiconductors) can still escape the leverage test.

Free tier-4 market data and no holdings data. Official expense ratios come from SEC risk/return filings; unit and grantor trusts and commodity pools file none (SPY, DIA, QQQ, GLD, SLV, DBC, USO), and the SEC data has added no filings since 2025-05-12 (quarters 2025q3-2026q2 parsed 0 rows; see expense_ratio_summary.json).

amendments.reason: The model universe admits only funds with at least $1M median daily dollar volume today, so a fund that was thinly traded in the past is in the universe only if it grew: past illiquidity selects past winners. Its negative IC (t -2.9) is a survivorship artifact, not a usable signal. Recorded after seeing results; it does not change the gate.

amendments.change: Cost-based ranking calls are enabled on the 36-month cost evidence (the charter's primary strategic horizon) instead of the registered 12-month gate, which the cost test did not pass.
amendments.reason: At 36 months a lower official expense ratio ranked peer-relative returns with t = 5.1 on yearly blocks, and the cheapest fifth of each peer group beat the most expensive fifth in 11 of 12 test years (most expensive fifth -1.37% a year against peers). Recorded as a change made after seeing results; the calls are labelled provisional and the evidence is published with them.

amendments.change: Peer-group rules (grouping version 2026-10-09.1). (1) Leverage and inverse exposure are read from the fund's beta on its near-identical twins in the universe (|r| >= 0.975): leveraged when it moves >= 1.6x a calmer twin (a twin that is a partial copy of the S&P 500, such as a 40/60 or buffer fund, does not count; funds under 10% volatility are never leveraged); bond funds are leveraged only at >= 1.6x the most volatile bond reference they track at >= 0.9; inverse when the beta to SPY is <= -0.5 and the twins agree (or, without twins, the correlation with SPY is <= -0.5), or as before when the fund mirrors a reference. (2) A fund that is SPY to >= 0.99 correlation is large blend. (3) A sector or real-estate group needs a style-analysis share >= 0.6 (the registered dominant_class_share, previously unused); otherwise the fund takes the nearest broad reference in its main asset class. (4) The live package classifies once per year at the prior December, as the research does, instead of every month.
amendments.reason: The audit found 1x total-market funds (VTI, ITOT, SCHB) in large value, QQQ moving to the technology sector month to month, leveraged funds in normal groups because the leverage test also required correlation >= 0.9 with a broad reference (SOXL beta 7.9, correlation 0.85; QLD, KORU, NUGT, JNUG, DPST, NAIL, RETL, HIBL, WEBL), a 2028 Treasury ladder (IBTI) flagged leveraged because it moves 1.9x SHY, and low-volatility and dividend funds (ACWV, LVHD, SPHD, HDV) in real estate or materials through their low beta. A beta >= 1.6 to SPY or to the nearest reference alone, as first proposed, would also have flagged unlevered semiconductor, gold-miner, preferred and international-bond funds, so twins are used instead. Effects after rerunning the research on the same data: the 'other' family's WAIT_FOR_DIP rule no longer passes its gate (share of starts beating monthly buying 0.605 -> 0.504), so no fund gets a WAIT verdict; the 36-month cost evidence weakens but still enables cost calls (t 4.69 -> 3.27; cheapest fifth beats the most expensive fifth in 0.833 -> 0.917 of years). Recorded as a change made after seeing results; the gate thresholds are unchanged.

amendments.change: Calls and readings in the package: (1) the call hysteresis registered in calls.hysteresis now runs, using the previous package's call (saved beside the hosted data), so a BUY at percentile 70-79 stays BUY; (2) call bands are read from calls.bands_percentile instead of a copy in code; (3) a family's timing-rule verdict is attached only to funds in the groups its family index is built from (for 'other': precious metals, commodities, real estate); idiosyncratic funds no longer inherit a rule verdict from the family of their nearest reference.
amendments.reason: The hysteresis was registered but the package always passed no previous call, and 54 funds, including FXI, MCHI, EWS, LABD and YINN, were told to wait for a 20% dip because the blended 'other' family's rule was applied to them loosely.

cost_test.factor: official net expense ratio (gross when net is missing) from the latest SEC risk/return filing on or before each month-end
cost_test.sign: fixed in advance: lower cost is better; no sign or weight is fitted to the data
cost_test.if_passes: ranking calls use each fund's cost percentile within its peer group with the policy bands (cheapest 20% BUY, next 20% ACCUMULATE, middle HOLD, most expensive 20% AVOID); funds without an official expense ratio get RANKED_NO_CALL
cost_test.if_fails: cost is shown as a reading only and ranking calls stay NO_VALIDATED_RANKING_EDGE
